run_order: 1. O_A and O_B, all four models.

2. One-at-a-time deviations from O_A for every non-origin level of every axis (including O_B-only origin levels, which are uncertain relative to O_A); then the same from O_B. When a level is identical to the active origin's level, skip it as a duplicate and record it.
3. Algebraic checks R24.mean1 and R26.centered at both origins.
4. No crossings beyond step 2: the equivalent set contains only algebraic checks, so there are no substantive equivalent crossings.
compatibility: R06.fdic_roa changes only the ROA numerator/denominator source; the expense ratio keeps the R05/R06 origin denominator.
R22.year: drop real_market_growth (collinear with year indicators) and report this.
R13.components uses the R15 level of the active origin.
budget: At most 400 specification settings x 4 models per implementer plus registered influence fits; total wall time 2 hours per implementer.
